exact_statement: For every fixed finite Boolean sign table under independent Bernoulli inputs, the normalized mixed-difference polynomials c_S=2^(-|S|) E Delta_S f give P(S)=w_S c_S^2, natural corrected entropy E=sum_nonempty w_S c_S^2 ln(1/c_S^2), and D=I-Var=sum_|S|>=2 (|S|-1)w_S c_S^2, with path-independent deterministic contraction. For one rare probability e and fixed interior remaining biases, E=E(g)+e K+2e^2 Z ln(1/e)+O(e^2) and D=D(g)+e L-e^2 Q, with K,Z,L,Q as in REPORT.md. If D(g)=0, either L=Q=0 and E=D=0 identically, or L>0 and Hplus/D tends to K/(L ln2). Zero-deficit interior Boolean tables are exactly constants and signed literals; a unit spectral atom after contraction is a signed parity on fair occupied coordinates.
